description: This Zenodo archive contains train-by-train traffic measurements from a weigh-in-motion system on the Alcácer do Sal railway bridge in Portugal. The article reports axle loads, axle spacing, speed and classified train type from 565 trains recorded intermittently during 2012–2013, amounting to about two months of monitoring. Rail-pad fibre-optic sensors and rail-shear strain gauges produced the measurements. The public Zenodo record 14212707 lists one ZIP under CC BY 4.0; the article describes MATLAB files inside the dataset and a 100-train labelled subset used to train classifiers. Coverage is one bridge and is weighted toward August and September 2012. Interruptions and classifier-derived train labels are limitations for estimating uninterrupted annual traffic or national fleet loads. A reviewer-assessed use is supplying realistic axle-train scenarios for rail bridge fatigue or traffic simulation. model-opentrack is a related rail-operation model, but no axle-load import or calibration was tested. No archive was downloaded.
